coverageNotes: Enumeration proposal only, not a published course, complete CEFR level or frozen unique inventory. Original Wordfold sense glosses and rationale; PCIC is acknowledged as a reference framework, not certification or endorsement.

All 65 primary legacy S identities individually reconciled: 411–420 (10 economy), 431–435 (5 civic), 451–455 (5 belief), 456–500 (45 nature). References retain stable IDs even where the proposed introduction level is later.

Selected bounded scenarios cover immediate money and buyer/seller relations; company/place versus person; country/capital and basic public roles; voluntary affiliation and worship buildings; settlements, cardinal directions, sky, simple weather and seasons; plant/animal recognition; immediate familiar materials and wet/dry/clean/dirty contrasts.

Applicable specific-notion subcategories are dispositioned: 15.1 money selected, 15.2 empty, 15.3 transactions selected/marketing strategy later, 15.4 company/workplace roles reused from W/H, 15.5 production later with H food and S animal references; 17.1 neighbor-person reused with broader conduct in P/D, 17.2 role names selected/processes later, 17.3 lawyer role selected/legal reasoning later, 17.4 military later; 19 affiliation/place recognition selected/doctrine later; 20.1 visible sky selected/science later, 20.2 geographic identification selected/detailed grouping later, 20.3 familiar urban/rural places selected, 20.4 simple conditions and seasons selected/explanatory climate later, 20.5/20.6 bounded animals/plants selected/taxonomy and processes later.

Open sets are bounded by course-relevant scenarios, not a numerical target: Spain and Slovakia as country names, common volunteered affiliation contrasts, familiar household/farm/outdoor animals, and elementary visible plant categories. Do not infer learner nationality, ethnicity, religion or access needs; additional names can be personalized without claiming an exhaustive world lexicon.

Shared F/P/H/T/W/C uses are not net-new meanings. Critical boundaries: country versus nationality/language; institution versus person/building; east NOUN versus este DET; morning/afternoon NOUN versus tomorrow/late ADV; weather tiempo versus duration; ambient heat/cold versus bodily sensation; living pez versus pescado food; soil versus planet; payment billete/card versus existing travel-document/generic-card meanings.

Exact planned links cover the demonstrative, bare-price quantity question, change returned after payment, and all five B2 public-issues plans. Other next-selection identities were checked by meaning: no dedicated A1 nature or affiliation entries exist among the 138; unrelated numeric, routine, discourse and advanced rhetorical plans are not adopted merely because they could appear in a social conversation.

Existing B2 desigualdad, sostenible, privacidad, impacto, recurso and concienciar are explicit later-domain references, not A1 coverage. General argument/professional/rhetorical verbs remain D/W responsibilities rather than being duplicated as every possible S context.

First omission pass added buyer versus customer, cash/card/coin/banknote and currency-exchange contrasts, workplace-organization links and concrete country names. Material/moisture A1 proposals explicitly conflict with F's A2 general boundary and require adjudication; these are narrow immediate-use choices, not automatic promotions for all tangible words.

No deferred-core objective remains in this bounded A1 proposal. Uncertainties are genuine global ownership, meaning granularity, morphology or level decisions; structural validation does not resolve them or authorize freeze.

Written pronunciation notes identify stress, spelling and contrast risks only. No native Spanish/Slovak approval, audio listening, learner-text authoring, global deduplication or publication occurred.
